description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientDirectory class within the Orleans runtime. The class maintains routing information for clients, handles updates from cluster membership changes, synchronizes routing tables across silos, and supports client lookup operations. It also manages publishing client routes to successor silos in a ring topology and integrates with lifecycle management.

classes.name: ClientDirectory
classes.description: Manages routing information for clients, handles membership and connection updates, and propagates routing table changes across silos.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a given GrainId, attempting local lookup first, then remote directories if necessary.

methods.name: TryLocalLookup
methods.description: Attempts to find local client routes for a GrainId within the current snapshot.

methods.name: OnUpdateClientRoutes
methods.description: Handles updates to the routing table received from remote silos.

methods.name: GetClientRoutes
methods.description: Returns routing information for silos with outdated or missing route data, based on a version vector.
